bunq Travel Insurance Guide

Traveling abroad? bunq Easy Money and Easy Green users enjoy automatic travel insurance coverage for medical emergencies, lost luggage, and trip cancellations. You can activate or deactivate travel insurance from your app settings under 'Insurance'.

To confirm coverage, ensure your plan is active and that your country of residence supports insurance. For full terms, visit: https://together.bunq.com/d/travel-insurance

Saving for Your Dream Trip

Create a dedicated sub-account for your travel goal by tapping '+ Add Account' and naming it 'Summer in Portugal 🌞'. Set a target amount and deadline. You can enable AutoSave to round up your daily expenses and automatically funnel change into your trip fund.

More tips: https://together.bunq.com/d/travel-savings

Using bunq Abroad

bunq cards are accepted worldwide wherever Mastercard is supported. Avoid hidden fees by using the bunq Travel Card or Easy Green plan, which includes zero foreign exchange markups. Enable notifications to track spending instantly.

Learn more: https://together.bunq.com/d/bunq-abroad

How to Enable AutoSave

AutoSave helps you save effortlessly by rounding up your card payments to the nearest euro. These small amounts are added to a savings sub-account of your choice. Great for building a travel fund over time!

Set it up from your sub-account settings or in the main app menu under 'AutoSave'.

Creating Sub-Accounts for Budgeting

Sub-accounts let you organize your money. Want to budget €1,500 for an Italy trip? Create a new sub-account, add a budget limit, and track progress. You can even share it with travel companions!

Start here: https://together.bunq.com/d/sub-accounts
